title: BECE Basic Technology & Computer Science - Basic Technology - Rescue Operations
subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: The first step in a rescue operation for an electric shock victim is to:
options: Pull the victim away with your hands
questions.explain: You must switch off the power source first. Touching the victim while they are still in contact with the live current will shock the rescuer as well.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: When rescuing a drowning person, why is it safer to throw a rope or float rather than jumping in?
options: The rescuer might be pulled down by the panic-stricken victim
It is faster to wait for a boat
questions.explain: A drowning victim is often in a state of panic and may grab the rescuer, potentially drowning both. The 'Reach, Throw, Row, Go' rule prioritizes assisting from a distance first.
